answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 38291 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: I had a dream few months back I have a cousin and I like him, so in my dream Question: I had a dream few months back I have a cousin and I like him, so in my dream I saw that I make a dua that O Allah make me and him get married with each other and I try to touch ka'abah but my hands come back second time again I ask Allah same dua and I try to touch ka'abah but my hands come back and third time I ask Allah to forgive my sins and my hands touch ka'abah easily then I heard a voice Someira and I saw some man standing on my right side and he said to me look there so when I look at ka'abah door I saw my same cousin standing in front of ka'abah door and all the light from inside ka'abah is coming outside over him. And he is making dua what does this dream mean? Answer ID: 38291 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 783/455/L=1433) If your proposal is final with your cousin then you should marry him, it shall bring virtue and blessing, in-shaAllah. However, it is necessary to maintain the Shariah limit in marriage. You should get married with the consent of your parents and should not go ahead yourself. Also do not have any contact with your cousin before marriage. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
